analyst.summary: KPIT Technologies builds specialized software for automakers' next-generation vehicles, and its growth has slowed sharply this quarter as some large European car manufacturers cut back their R&D spending amid their own profit warnings and weak EV demand. Management expects the slowdown to ease in the second half of the year. The stock has already fallen a great deal, which has brought its valuation down to a more reasonable level for a still financially strong, high-return business. We rate it a Hold: real near-term pain from client-side cuts, but the long-term shift toward software-heavy vehicles remains intact and the price has already adjusted.
